class.name: NetwCallPark
class.brief_description: The calls that arrived before the route they address, and the budget one sender may hold there.

method.name: active_count
method.description: How many rows [param sender] holds, whether or not they have run. A row stops counting when [method sweep] drops it.

method.name: clear
method.description: Drops every row and the refusal count with them. The count is a session statistic, and one carried across sessions would attribute one session's budget pressure to the next.

method.name: park
method.description: Parks one call against [param route] and answers its id, or [code]-1[/code] when [param sender] is at its budget. The deadline is a tick the caller reads from its own clock, because this book has none.

method.name: refused
method.description: How many parks the budget refused this session.

method.name: resolve
method.description: Marks the call [param id] names as run, and answers whether it was still waiting. It answers [code]true[/code] exactly once, which is what stops a route that binds twice from running one call twice.

method.name: route_of
method.description: The route [param id] was parked against, or [code]0[/code] once its row is gone.

method.name: size
method.description: Rows still in the book, run and waiting alike, until the next [method sweep].

method.name: sweep
method.description: Drops every row that has run and every row whose deadline [param now] has reached, so the budget counts only calls that are still owed an answer.
